html:
G'oya

Chipta ro'yxatga tushadi, agar xuddi shu poyezd, vagon va o'ringa sotilgan boshqa faol chipta bo'lsa. "Boshqa" so'zi muhim: o.id <> t.id bo'lmasa, har bir chipta o'zini topadi. Joy uch ustundan iborat, uchalasi ham solishtiriladi.

Yechim

SELECT id, train, car, seat, passenger
FROM tickets t
WHERE status = 'faol'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tickets o
    WHERE o.train = t.train
      AND o.car = t.car
      AND o.seat = t.seat
      AND o.status = 'faol'
      AND o.id <> t.id
  )

O'rinsiz chiptalar o'z-o'zidan chetda qoladi: NULL = NULL rost emas, shuning uchun Bekzod va Dilnoza bir-birini "topmaydi". Holat sharti ikki joyda: tashqarida bekor qilingan chipta natijaga chiqmasin, ichkarida esa u boshqalarga "juft" bo'lmasin.

Tuzoqlar

Vagonni unutish. Jasur 3-vagonning 15-o'rnida, Aziz bilan Malika 2-vagonda. Faqat poyezd va o'rin solishtirilsa, Jasur ham ro'yxatga tushadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, train, car, seat, passenger
FROM tickets t
WHERE status = 'faol'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM tickets o
    WHERE o.train = t.train AND o.seat = t.seat
      AND o.status = 'faol' AND o.id <> t.id
  )

Ichki so'rovda holatni tekshirmaslik. Nodira chiptasini topshirgan, joy Sardorga qayta sotilgan. Bu to'qnashuv emas, lekin ichkarida status bo'lmasa, Sardor chiqib qoladi.

Boshqa yo'l

Avval ikki marta sotilgan joylarni guruhlab topib, keyin shu joylardagi chiptalarni olish. Uch ustunli IN ikkala dialektda ham ishlaydi:

SELECT id, train, car, seat, passenger
FROM tickets
WHERE status = 'faol'
  AND (train, car, seat) IN (
    SELECT train, car, seat
    FROM tickets
    WHERE status = 'faol'
    GROUP BY train, car, seat
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  )

Ichki so'rov seat NULL bo'lgan guruhni ham qaytarishi mumkin, lekin tashqi IN da NULL hech narsaga teng bo'lmaydi va bu chiptalar baribir chiqmaydi.
